import spacy

def get_synonyms(word, pos=None):
    """Return synonyms for a word, filtered by part-of-speech (POS)."""
    synonyms = set()
    for syn in wn.synsets(word, pos=pos):
        for lemma in syn.lemmas():
            synonyms.add(lemma.name().replace("_", " "))

def replace_synonyms(text, replacements):
    """Replace target words with synonyms from a dictionary."""

                yield token.text
